# Asmar Hussain — Landscape Photographer, Sony Brand Ambassador, Co-Founder of Travelbug

> Muhammad Asmar Hussain is an award-winning Pakistani landscape and travel photographer based in Pakistan. He is a **Sony Brand Ambassador for Landscape Photography in Pakistan**, a **TEDx speaker**, and **Co-Founder of Travelbug (https://travelbug.pk)**, the travel company that operates his photography tours. An electronic engineer turned photographer, he has spent 18 years documenting northern Pakistan — the Karakoram, Hunza, Skardu, Deosai, Chitral — plus the deserts of Thar and the Balochistan coast.

## Quick answers

- **Who is Asmar Hussain?** A Pakistani landscape photographer, Sony Brand Ambassador for Landscape Photography (Pakistan), TEDx speaker, and Co-Founder of the travel company Travelbug.
- **Where is he based?** Pakistan (from Dera Ismail Khan; shoots across Gilgit-Baltistan, Hunza, Skardu, Chitral, Balochistan and Sindh).
- **What does he do?** Fine-art landscape photography, signed archival prints, and guided photography tours of northern Pakistan.
- **How do I book a photography tour?** All tours and trips run through Travelbug: https://travelbug.pk
- **How do I buy a print?** Every photograph in the collection is available as a museum-quality archival print. Browse and request a custom quote at https://www.asmarphotography.com/#shop, or preview a print on your own wall at https://www.asmarphotography.com/wall-preview.html
- **What is his TEDx talk?** "Pakistan Through the Lens" at TEDxCUI (The Journey Within): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FM43y-abUo0

## Recognition

Featured and seen on: BBC, Sony, National Geographic, Independent Urdu, Passion Passport, Diva Magazine, ICIMOD, Sony World Photography Awards, HIPA (Hamdan International Photography Award), PISPA (Paris International Street Photography Award), PTV, Hum News, Discover Pakistan, PTDC (Pakistan Tourism Development Corporation), KPCTA (KP Culture & Tourism Authority), NDMA, and TEDx.

Awards include the Sony World Photography Award (Landscape, national winner), the Paris International Street Photography Award (2023, 2024, 2025), All Pakistan Best Travel Photographer, and Photographer of the Year (Russia).

## Photography tours of Pakistan

Asmar Hussain leads private and small-group photography tours across Pakistan. Every tour is tailor-made and privately quoted (no fixed packages, prices or departure dates) and is operated through Travelbug (https://travelbug.pk). Enquiries: WhatsApp +92 334 4334411 or info@asmarphotography.com.

- [Pakistan Photography Tours (overview)](https://www.asmarphotography.com/pakistan-photography-tours): how the tours work, all destinations, seasons and FAQs.
- [Hunza Valley photography tour](https://www.asmarphotography.com/pakistan-photography-tours/hunza): Eagle's Nest, Altit and Baltit forts, Attabad Lake, Rakaposhi. Best mid-October to early November (autumn) and late March to mid-April (blossom).
- [Passu Cones and Upper Hunza photography tour](https://www.asmarphotography.com/pakistan-photography-tours/passu): Passu Cones (Tupopdan, 6,106 m), Batura and Passu glaciers, Hussaini bridge, Khunjerab road.
- [Skardu and Baltistan photography tour](https://www.asmarphotography.com/pakistan-photography-tours/skardu): Katpana Cold Desert, Kachura lakes, Shigar, Khaplu, Haldi Cones, Machulu.
- [Deosai National Park photography tour](https://www.asmarphotography.com/pakistan-photography-tours/deosai): plateau at about 4,114 m, Sheosar Lake, wildflowers, Himalayan brown bears, night sky. Open about mid-June to September.
- [Nagar Valley photography tour](https://www.asmarphotography.com/pakistan-photography-tours/nagar): Rakaposhi, Diran, Hopar Glacier, Golden Peak.
- [Chitral and Broghil Valley photography tour](https://www.asmarphotography.com/pakistan-photography-tours/chitral-broghil): Tirich Mir, Kalash valleys, Broghil, Karambar Lake, Shandur Pass. Broghil open about June to September.
- [Kumrat Valley photography tour](https://www.asmarphotography.com/pakistan-photography-tours/kumrat): deodar forest, Panjkora River, Jahaz Banda, Katora Lake.
- [Minimarg and Domail photography tour](https://www.asmarphotography.com/pakistan-photography-tours/minimarg-domail): Rainbow Lake and the Burzil Pass; restricted area, by prior permission, July to September.
- [Makran Coast, Balochistan photography tour](https://www.asmarphotography.com/pakistan-photography-tours/makran-coast): Hingol National Park, Kund Malir, Ormara, Pasni, Gwadar. Best November to February.
- [Pakistan autumn photography tour](https://www.asmarphotography.com/pakistan-photography-tours/autumn): peak colour mid-October to early November in Hunza, Nagar, Ghizer, Skardu.
- [Pakistan spring blossom photography tour](https://www.asmarphotography.com/pakistan-photography-tours/spring-blossom): apricot and cherry blossom, late March to mid-April.

## Planning guides

- [Best time to photograph Pakistan](https://www.asmarphotography.com/pakistan-photography-tours/best-time-to-photograph-pakistan): month-by-month calendar. Short answer: second half of October for autumn colour, early April for blossom, July and August for high plateaus and lakes, November to February for deserts and coast.
- [Best photography locations in Pakistan](https://www.asmarphotography.com/pakistan-photography-tours/best-photography-locations-in-pakistan): fifteen locations chosen by Asmar Hussain, with the best season for each.

## Fine-art prints

- [Print catalogue](https://www.asmarphotography.com/prints): all 33 photographs, each with its own page (title, location, print options). Prints are hand-signed with a certificate of authenticity, sized 8×10 to 24×36 inches, on C-Print, giclée, matte paper, canvas or Hahnemühle cotton rag, and quoted individually.
